pages.title: Edge-walkers
text: “Boots first. Then the bridge. Then the courage; it arrives on its own.”

pages.title: Who they are
text: The Edge-walkers walked the rift edge where the thread frayed thinnest and set footholds for everyone who came after. Their craft is **Spiritgear and footholds**.
Their camps stand in **taiga**, and a second camp keeps the old road in the March highlands.

pages.title: What they want
text: Their reagent is the **Rift Tooth**, worth **+8** standing at their hearth.
They also favour Leather, an Iron Ingot or Raw Iron: **+3** each. Any other food is worth **+1**, and a charged Pulse Cell **+2 for every 10 Pulse**, up to +8.
Remember the hearth takes at most **60** standing a day from offerings; see [Tribes and standing](standing).

pages.title: What the Elder trades
text: **Guest**: 6 Leather for 2 Echo Shards; 4 Iron Ingots for Leather Boots.
**Friend**: 3 Attuned Echo and 4 Leather for Spiritweave Boots; 8 Iron Ingots for a Rift Tooth.
**Kin**: 3 Bound Echo for a Spiritgear Blade; 3 Bound Echo for a Spiritgear Pickaxe.

pages.title: Their Mark and totem
text: At **Voice** the Elder gives you the Edge-walkers' Tribe Mark. Craft it with a {item:tribalpower:resonance_totem_fire} and two Spiritweave into their [Kinship Totem](kinship_totem).
Beside a Pulse Resonator it is one more voice; beside a station it lends **Fire**.
Buying a Rift Tooth at Friend is a safer way to get their reagent than hunting Rift Hounds.
Kin of the Edge-walkers carry their [boon](tribe_boons): no fall hurts you while you **sneak**.
